m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I'd say Ali Baboon's defenses are running pretty thin at this point. All he's got left is this crazy Qhat to defend him.
What a grind, eh? I mean, Istar's definitely going to owe us for this, isn't she? Yeah, she will.
Hohoho! Hohoho! You are a crafty combatant, Wizard, Ali Baboon will give you that, but you have waded into deep sand now, coming into my Lounge.
Mirage was once ruled by the great Baboolonian Empire. I am descended directly from its kings, and I inherited their tremendous powers.
You embarrassed me back in the Underden, but now I will have my vengeance. To the last, I will grapple with thee...
Stay your spells, Wizard. Ali Baboon is defeated. You are here for your Djinni friend, yes? Fine, you may take her.
I hoped she would grant me wishes, but she refused me as a Master. Her lamp is in the Thieves Den Vault. Take the key.
Go to the Vault, rescue your Djinni friend and then begone from here, all of you. Ali Baboon will finally get some rest.
So wait, Ali Baboon surrendered? Just like that? I can't believe it. In the end, he turned out to be a pushover, didn't he?
I wouldn't normally stick up for a crime lord, but he was actually a pretty tough biscuit. I think he just knows when to cut his losses.
We were going to leave, but if he's holding your friend hostage, we'll stick around to make sure she's all right. Good luck in there, Wizard.
Don't worry. We'll stay out here and make sure everything stays cool. You go in there and get Ali Baboon to release your friend.
